content:
OpenAI has previewed more than 20 announcements set to be revealed at its DevDay 2026 event. The event will be live-streamed.

We expect the big announcement to be ChatGPT's response to SpaceXAI Grok Bot and Meta Muse, bringing broader consumer appeal to existing AI agent tools.

OpenAI already has similar functionality under the ChatGPT Work framework, but its presentation isn't as streamlined as Muse and Grok Bot.

In any case, you can watch the live event on the hour, every hour. The event will kick off at 10am PT / 1pm ET.
